title: Nearly 1 in 10 young adults could have fatty, narrow arteries | New Scientist
description: Atherosclerosis, the build-up of fatty plaque in arteries, usually affects people older than 50, but a "meaningful" proportion of younger adults also have the condition
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: Rising water is creating inland ghost forests in the US | New Scientist
description: Forests full of dead trees aren’t just found by the US coasts – they are also appearing far from the sea around freshwater lakes
author: Chris Simms

title: Number of known species of giant waterlilies almost doubles | New Scientist
description: A new species of giant waterlily identified with the help of social media and satellite photos is just one of three discovered in the past few years
author: Michael Le Page

title: The big unanswered question about Russia's 'plague' death | New Scientist
description: Russia says it is winding down precautionary measures taken after a lab worker at a plague research institute died. But what made officials think these were needed at all?
author: Michael Le Page

title: OpenAI mistranslated mathematics into code for its Navier-Stokes proof | New Scientist
description: When OpenAI announced its surprise solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, it produced one proof for humans and one for computers – however, they don't match
author: Jacob Aron

title: Record El Niño threatens Great Barrier Reef with ecological shift | New Scientist
description: Researchers are worried about the impact the strongest-known El Niño will have on the Great Barrier Reef, and whether anything can be done to avert the World Heritage Area’s demise
author: James Woodford
